meta.description: Meridian Commerce financial model parameters — customer value, resolution costs, damage exposure

sku_md4821wn.notes: A fully resolved damage complaint with expedited replacement costs Meridian $52 more than the gross margin on the original sale. Every damage incident is margin-negative regardless of resolution path.

customer_economics.notes: A customer who receives proactive outreach before complaining has a 4% churn rate. A customer whose complaint goes unresolved has a 73% churn rate. The delta in lifetime value between these two outcomes for a Gold tier customer is approximately $2,073 per incident.

in_transit_at_risk.notes: Proactive outreach before delivery costs nothing. Reactive resolution after complaint costs $235 and risks $540 in LTV.

purchase_order_pipeline_risk.notes: If PO-2024-8821 is not held and root cause is unresolved at supplier and carrier level, incoming stock will produce an estimated 14 additional damage incidents generating $3,290 in resolution costs and placing $22,680 in customer lifetime value at risk.

scenario_low.label: Best case — immediate action taken today
assumptions: Phoenix warehouse routing suspended within 24 hours
PO-2024-8821 held pending supplier quality confirmation
Proactive outreach to Maria Santos, James Okafor, Robert Tillman today
Supplier quality review initiated this week
FastShip performance notice issued this week

scenario_mid.label: Mid case — action taken this week
assumptions: Routing change implemented within 5 business days
PO-2024-8821 reviewed but not immediately held
Reactive resolution for Maria Santos and James Okafor
No proactive outreach to Robert Tillman before delivery

scenario_high.label: Worst case — no action taken, PO-2024-8821 received
assumptions: 200 unit PO received January 2025 with unresolved defect
scenario_high.notes: Worst case assumes the defect pattern propagates through the January 2025 PO at current damage rates with no operational intervention. The $89k-$142k LTV range reflects uncertainty in churn rates and review impact. The resolution cost range reflects variable take rates on expedited vs standard replacement.

executive_summary.headline: A single customer complaint has revealed a systemic operational risk with a total exposure range of $89,000 to $142,000 in customer lifetime value if left unresolved.
executive_summary.cost_of_inaction: $18,400 to $34,700 in direct resolution costs plus $89,000 to $142,000 in lifetime value exposure
key_decisions_required: Authorise immediate Phoenix warehouse routing suspension for SKU MD-4821-WN
Place hold on PO-2024-8821 pending Crestwood supplier quality review
Approve proactive customer outreach to Maria Santos, James Okafor, Robert Tillman
Issue formal carrier performance notice to FastShip re: PHX-FSH-04 breach of notification clause 7.3
executive_summary.urgency: SAME DAY — Robert Tillman's order delivers December 16. Maria Santos is one contact away from chargeback.
